# featbit_member_policy_binding (Resource)

Manages one exact FeatBit Member-to-Policy binding through the documented public API. It owns only the configured pair, not either endpoint or the Member's complete direct Policy collection.

This additive resource owns only one exact direct Member-Policy pair. It does
not require the Member's current direct Policy baseline, and Create never
removes another direct Policy. The Member must already exist; this provider
does not invite, create, update, remove from the organization or workspace, or
delete Members. If the pair already exists, Create adopts that relationship
into state without another add mutation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "member_emails_by_alias" {
  description = "Non-identifying aliases mapped to organization-scoped full emails of existing FeatBit Members."
  type        = map(string)
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "policy_key" {
  description = "Organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact custom or built-in Policy key."
  type        = string
}

locals {
  member_aliases = nonsensitive(toset(keys(var.member_emails_by_alias)))
}

data "featbit_member" "target" {
  for_each = local.member_aliases

  email = var.member_emails_by_alias[each.key]
}

data "featbit_policy" "target" {
  key = var.policy_key
}

resource "featbit_member_policy_binding" "example" {
  for_each = local.member_aliases

  member_id = data.featbit_member.target[each.key].id
  policy_id = data.featbit_policy.target.id
}
```

The example uses non-identifying aliases as `for_each` keys so Member emails
do not become Terraform resource addresses. Member identifiers and the
synthetic binding IDs are Sensitive. Treat state, plans, and terminal output
as confidential even though the example contains no real Member value.

## Ownership choice

Do not manage the same Member with both this resource and
`featbit_member_direct_policies`. The latter intentionally owns the Member's
complete direct Policy set, while this resource owns only one pair. Overlapping
the two ownership models can cause conflicting plans or removal of a binding.

## Lifecycle

- Changing either endpoint replaces the binding.
- Read scans the complete direct Policy collection for this exact pair; it
  never treats inherited Group Policies as direct assignments.
- Destroy removes only this pair and preserves every unrelated direct Policy,
  inherited Policy, Group membership, and the Member itself.
- The Policy can be custom or built-in. Removing the binding never deletes or
  changes either endpoint.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member_id` (String, Sensitive) Exact existing Member UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `policy_id` (String) Exact custom or built-in Policy UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String, Sensitive) Canonical synthetic binding ID in `<member_uuid>/<policy_uuid>` form.

## Import

Import one exact direct Member-Policy pair:

```shell
terraform import 'featbit_member_policy_binding.example["test-member"]' '<member_uuid>/<policy_uuid>'
```

Both components must use canonical 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal UUID form. The
Member component and resulting synthetic ID are Sensitive in Terraform.
